name: How long does it take to install baseboards in a typical room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install baseboards in a typical room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install baseboards depends on the room size, complexity of cuts (e.g., numerous corners or curved walls), and whether old baseboards need removal. For an average-sized room, installation can typically take a single day. However, larger projects or those requiring significant preparation or custom finishes will extend the timeline. Finishing tasks like caulking and painting add further time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for baseboards varies by room size and complexity, often taking one day for a typical room, excluding finishing.
